+def _jobs(data):
+    from itertools import combinations
+
+    jobs = [job for job in data["jobs"]
+            if job["id"] not in data.get("blocked", [])]
+    k = data["k"]
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    if not mandatory.issubset({j["id"] for j in jobs}) or len(mandatory) > k:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    for selected in combinations(jobs, k):
+        ids = [j["id"] for j in selected]
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in selected:
+            group = job["group"]
+            counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+        if any(not lo <= counts.get(group, 0) <= hi
+               for group, (lo, hi) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        valid = True
+        for job in selected:
+            overlap = sum(other["start"] <= job["start"] < other["end"]
+                          for other in selected)
+            if overlap > 2:
+                valid = False
+                break
+        if not valid:
+            continue
+        sorted_ids = sorted(ids)
+        value = sum(j["value"] for j in selected)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and sorted_ids > best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, sorted_ids
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
